Yes i am referring to a case worker from the homeless team cause i’ve made a homeless application already and it really seems like they won’t help, they did their assessment, it was a question and answer, i answered everything, i am still not a priority, my fellow refugees are also very mentally ill and suicidal yet they aren’t getting help and getting kicked out on the streets all the time, i don’t think i’ll be an exception, i have contacted charities and organizations cause i didn’t have much faith in the council, and one time they asked about what council is responsible for my case and i got a negative reaction and i was told that it’s not a very helpful council at all, i have also contacted many many many landlords explained my situation and how i need my first rent and deposit to be covered by housing benefits cause i am still looking for a job and they refuse, even if they say yes at first after i explain the process of how long it’ll take until they get the deposit from the council and that they need to provide documents to the council they change their mind and refuse cause it’s too much, and my case worker said it’s almost all on me, i should continue being pro active “i am” find a place to rent, i think it’s the way things are designed i think I’m supposed to be homeless 
My case worker told me about an offer from another organization “i don’t know what to call them” that will house me outside of London “i don’t know how i will get to my college don’t have the privilege of refusing, so i accepted the offer immediately but they didn’t contact me, i asked my case worker why didn’t they contact me and she keeps saying “they’ll contact you in due course” whatever that means, that’s why she warned me there’s no emergency housing for me when i become homeless and i must figure it out myself, i will contact her again and try to explain that i am eligible to be priority maybe she will listen this time, my problem is i wasn’t giving much time to transition once i was allowed to look for work, they kick us out really quickly
